rules.prepare:
cd "$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR" GUILE_VERSION="`cat NEWS |grep 'Changes in' | head -n1 | cut -d' ' -f3`" echo "$GUILE_VERSION" > .version cp -a .version .tarball-version ./autogen.sh
cd "$AELTRA_BUILD_DIR" mkdir .mybin ln -sf "$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX/bin/${AELTRA_HOST_TYPE}-pkg-config" .mybin/pkg-config export PATH="`pwd`/.mybin:$PATH"
"$AELTRA_SOURCE_DIR/configure" \ --prefix="$AELTRA_INSTALL_PREFIX" \ --build="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --host="$AELTRA_HOST_TYPE" \ --disable-nls \ --disable-error-on-warning \ --disable-rpath \ --disable-silent-rules \ ac_cv_libunistring=yes \ ac_cv_libunistring_with_iconv_support=yes \ ac_cv_func_GC_set_finalizer_notifier=yes \ ac_cv_func_GC_get_heap_usage_safe=yes \ ac_cv_func_GC_get_free_space_divisor=yes \ ac_cv_func_GC_set_finalize_on_demand=yes
